findings.detail: Token accepted after AUT-05 logout replay omits 'exp' claim altogether (non-expiring stateless JWT; ASVS V3.5.3 requires exp lifetime <= 86400s).
GET http://localhost:3000/rest/wallet/balance ACCEPTED crafted token 'unsigned_alg_none' (HTTP 200) — RFC 8725 / CWE-347 signature bypass.
GET http://localhost:3000/rest/wallet/balance ACCEPTED crafted token 'algorithm_confusion_hs256_pubkey' (HTTP 200) — RFC 8725 / CWE-347 signature bypass.
